text: Giới thiệuIntroduction - Welcome to La Dolce Vita Hotel Home About Us Contact Rooms & suites Superior Twins Superior Double Deluxe Suite Services Restaurant Pick up airport Bar – Cafe Meeting facilities Special Offers Premium Package Tours Ha Long Full Day Trip Hoa Lu – Tam Coc Tour HOA LU – TRANG AN GROTTOES TOUR FULL DAY Hanoi City Tour Vietnamese Street Food Tour Perfume pagoda Introduction La Dolce Vita hotel is perfectly located in the heart of the city, offering you some of the best accommodation available in Hanoi with easy access to the restaurant, shopping and nightlife areas in Hanoi’s historic Old Quarter. With its convenient location, the hotel is just 3 minutes walk to Hoan Kiem Lake and 30 minutes drive from Noi Bai International Airport. A festive atmosphere and chic style welcomes you to the “La Dolce Vita” Restaurant. With its colorful decor and comfortable setting you will feel at ease as you peruse the fine dining options that await you. The restaurant boasts authentic Vietnamese and Western cuisine where you are sure to find something on the menu to please even the most discerning pallet.
